planets.name: Mercury
planets.summary: Mercury is the smallest and innermost planet in the Solar System. It is a rocky planet with no natural satellites.

planets.name: Venus
planets.summary: Venus is the second planet from the Sun and the hottest planet in our solar system.

planets.name: Earth
planets.summary: Earth is the third planet from the Sun.

planets.name: Mars
planets.summary: Mars is the fourth planet from the Sun and the second-smallest planet in the Solar System.

planets.name: Jupiter
planets.summary: Jupiter is the fifth planet from the Sun and the largest in the Solar System. It is a gas giant with a mass about two and a half times that of all the other planets combined.

planets.name: Saturn
planets.summary: Saturn is the sixth planet from the Sun and the second-largest in the Solar System, after Jupiter. It is a gas giant with an average radius about nine times that of Earth.

planets.name: Uranus
planets.summary: Uranus is the seventh planet from the Sun and the third-largest in the Solar System. It is a gas giant with an average radius about four times that of Earth.

planets.name: Neptune
planets.summary: Neptune is the eighth and farthest-known planet from the Sun in the Solar System. It is the fourth-largest planet by diameter, the third-most-massive planet, and the densest giant planet.
